From the tables

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

Piale Pasa 24

Charmers opened its doors in 1992 and has stood on the Larnaca seafront ever since, a fish tavern and steak house in one. Under the blue awning are tables on the pavement, behind it a covered terrace with white chairs and blue and white cloths, and the sea is right across the road. Guests on Google write most often about octopus, the seafood platter and the view; with 927 reviews and 4.2 stars, several of them mention that they have been coming back for years.

Open every day from twelve noon until half past ten in the evening. Eat in, take away or delivery. Cash and cards are accepted. There is no website yet, and the restaurant’s own entry on Google has not been claimed by anyone.

What guests say

Two of 927 Google reviews, 4.2 stars on average.

“I first ate here 9 years ago during my visit to Larnaca, and the quality is still great. The food is delicious and the portions are quite generous. I tried the fried calamari and the pork gyros, which comes with fries, salad, and rice. The service is also very good and efficient. Definitely worth a visit!”
